*ITMBELOW.when: `ITEM`'s count (hot and cold together) drops below `VALUE`. With `TYPE(*FLUID)` or `TYPE(*PRES)`, a fluid's or gas's amount in mB.
*ITMBELOW.data: The item ID and its count: `IRON_INGOT 499` (a fluid: `minecraft:water 3000`)

*ITMABOVE.when: `ITEM`'s count rises above `VALUE` (as `*ITMBELOW`, the other way).
*ITMABOVE.data: The item ID and its count: `COBBLESTONE 10001`

*STGFULL.when: The network's storage use (source members included) reaches `VALUE` percent, or 100 with no `VALUE`.

*DEVFAULT.when: The device `DEV` (or any named device, `*ANY`) goes into fault.

*DEVOFFLINE.when: `DEV` (or any named device) goes offline from online or fault. A device that is disabled counts as offline.

*PWRUPS.when: The network's UPSes go onto battery (the network has lost its power).

*PWRRESTORED.when: The network's UPSes come back off battery.

*CRAFTEND.when: A crafting job of `ITEM` (or any, `*ANY`) ends, whether it finished, failed or was cancelled.
*CRAFTEND.data: The crafting job and how it ended: `C0042 *DONE` (`*DONE`, `*FAILED` or `*CANCELLED`)

*CRFSTALL.when: A crafting job of `ITEM` (or any) makes no progress for {{config autocrafting.jobStallSeconds default}} seconds.
*CRFSTALL.data: The job, the item of the step it is stuck on and the reason when one was found: `C0042 IRON_INGOT machine output full`

*RSCHANGE.when: The redstone arriving on a face of the Control Interface or PLC `DEV` changes. `VALUE('*NORTH')` (or another side) fires for that face only.
*RSCHANGE.data: The face and its new level: `*NORTH 7`

*DSPTOUCH.when: A player right-clicks the face of the Display Panel screen `DEV` (or any).
*DSPTOUCH.data: The screen, the region under the point (`*NONE` outside all of them) and the point in canvas pixels from the top left: `DSP01 A 40 12`

*MCHIDLE.when: An Arcforge machine `DEV` (or any) with a Small Wireless Bridge on it goes idle.
*MCHIDLE.data: The machine's name, then the words Arcforge gives for its status

*MCHDONE.when: A bridged Arcforge machine `DEV` (or any) finishes an operation; `ITEM` can name what it must have made.
*MCHDONE.data: The machine, the count and the first thing it made: `ARCCRU01 5 BONE_MEAL`

*MCHFAULT.when: A bridged Arcforge machine `DEV` (or any) faults.
*MCHFAULT.data: The machine and the machine's words: `ARCCRU01 Too hot`

*MCHNOPWR.when: A bridged Arcforge machine `DEV` (or any) runs short of power.
*MCHNOPWR.data: The machine and the machine's words: `ARCCRU01 No power`

*NBRUP.when: A dynamic-routing neighbour of the Router `DEV` (or any) comes up.
*NBRUP.data: The Router and the neighbour's network: `RTR01 ELNET02`

*NBRDOWN.when: A dynamic-routing neighbour of the Router `DEV` (or any) goes down.
*NBRDOWN.data: The Router and the neighbour's network

*RTECHG.when: The Router `DEV`'s (or any Router's) best path to a network changes: a new next hop or cost, or a route found or lost.
*RTECHG.data: The Router and the network: `RTR01 ELNET07`

*ACLDENY.when: An ACL rule on the Router `DEV` (or any) denies a resource. At most once a second for each rule.
*ACLDENY.data: The Router, the ACL, the rule's sequence number and the resource: `RTR01 NOFUEL 10 COAL`

*CARDFAULT.when: A part in the chassis `DEV` (or any) fails or is taken out: a Chassis Switch's power supply or its last supervisor, a Blade Enclosure's interconnect, management or power modules, a Transport Shelf's controller.
*CARDFAULT.data: The device, the bay and what happened: `CSW01 PSU 3/4 power supplies`, `CSW01 A no supervisor`, `OTS01 C controller failover`

*SUPFAILOVER.when: The standby supervisor of the Chassis Switch `DEV` (or any) takes over from the active one.
*SUPFAILOVER.data: The switch, the bay that failed and the takeover: `CSW01 A failover to B`

*PROTSWITCH.when: The Transport Shelf `DEV` (or any) switches between its working and protect paths (1+1 protection).
*PROTSWITCH.data: The shelf, the span, the path now in use and why: `OTS01 OTS01-OTS02 *PROTECT working path down`

*SPANLOSS.when: The lanes lost on the active span of the Transport Shelf `DEV` (or any) change, up or down.
*SPANLOSS.data: The shelf, the span and the lanes now lost: `OTS01 OTS01-OTS02 2`
